title: Cembranoids from the cultured soft coral Sinularia sandensis
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,12275-12281
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00391E, Paper

Kuei-Hung Lai, Chih-Yuan Liang, You-Ying Chen, Ting-Wei Liao, Lo-Yun Chen, Bo-Rong Peng, Jui-Hsin Su, Mohamed El-Shazly
This study reports the isolation and characterization of two novel diterpenoids, norcembranoid 10-epi-dehydrogyrosanolide E (1) and cembranoid 8-epi-flexibilisolide G (2), from the cultured soft coral Sinularia sandensis.
